releaseNotes: Added a personal build flavor with a configurable app name and original equalizer launcher/notification branding.
Added a tap-to-skip 3.2-second startup intro and persisted Now Playing speed presets.
Made Stats for Nerds distinguish source-reported claims from current Media3 renderer information; unknown values remain explicit.
Added GitHub-based in-app updates with bounded checks, version comparison, verified Void Music APK selection, SHA-256/signing checks, download progress and installer-result verification.
Added a Software Update option in Settings to manually check GitHub, show the installed/available versions, and open the update download/install flow.
Added missing Simplified and Traditional Chinese strings.
migrationNotes: The Android application ID is com.voidmusic.player. This beta update preserves data only when installed over a matching package and signing certificate. This APK uses the Android debug certificate; update compatibility with builds signed by other keys is not supported.
